mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25 percentage points in the prior month (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 0.5 percentage points in one month signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5 percentage points in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate strengthening consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95, it signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during recessionary supply shocks.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate signals expanding economic activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate does not correlate with positive 5-day S&P 500 returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment and increase in employment indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0%.
